game.name: Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Ship of Harkinian)
game.desc: The PC version of Ocarina of Time: free camera on the right stick, widescreen, 60 fps. Choose Master Quest when you start a new file. Controller: X / Y / RB = C-left / C-right / C-down, click the right stick = C-up (look). Hold View + Menu to quit.
